task_selection_rule: Deterministic nested stratification by historical mode, weekday, distance quartile, time-window quartile and hazard class.
fleet_scaling_rule: K=ceil(N * admitted active vehicles / empirically time-feasible source tasks), with minimum 5.
vehicle_selection_rule: Active self-owned vehicles passing the 80th risk percentile, ordered by historical activity then risk percentile.
duration_rule: Direct historical loaded-OD median when available; otherwise historical distance-bin median. Tasks are retained only if the empirical duration fits the observed positive appointment window. No artificial cap is used.
scenario_rule: 100 equally likely empirical driver-month event-rate vectors sampled from the withheld calibration panel; task sensitivities vary by distance, window and hazard class.
external_cost_definition: Ex-ante quotation proxy, not actual settlement.
formal_use: Held-out exact validation and Gurobi crossover. No parameter tuning is permitted on these instances.
benchmark_purpose: Natural-completion compact Gurobi benchmark for future algorithm comparisons.
gurobi_stopping_rule: Gurobi terminates naturally; OPTIMAL requires MIPGap <= 1e-6.
compatibility_rule: q_ki=1 when the anonymized vehicle and task share the recorded deidentified hazard-class code. All retained benchmark pairs are homogeneous under the available class code; no artificial incompatibility is introduced.
admission_rule: Vehicles were selected from units passing the 80th risk-percentile policy. admission_indicator is retained explicitly; non-admitted units may be omitted as an equivalent presolve.
